about.title: TODO_TRANSLATE: A packaging line, not a catalogue.
about.intro: TODO_TRANSLATE: Azhar Products makes thermoformed food packaging for dairy, dessert and food-service producers. The short version: we build the tool, run the sheet, and ship the format you actually need.

origin.title: TODO_TRANSLATE: Built around one question from buyers.
origin.body: TODO_TRANSLATE: Every enquiry starts the same way — can you make this format, at this volume, for this fill? The company was organised around answering yes more often than a catalogue supplier can, which is why tooling sits alongside production rather than at a vendor.

facility.title: TODO_TRANSLATE: Extrusion, forming and finishing in sequence.
facility.body: TODO_TRANSLATE: Sheet extrusion, thermoforming, trimming, stacking and packing run as one line. Material moves in a single pass, which keeps handling low and makes short runs of a custom format economic rather than exceptional.

quality.title: TODO_TRANSLATE: Food contact is a process, not a certificate on a wall.
quality.body: TODO_TRANSLATE: Material selection, forming temperature, handling and packing all follow documented food-contact procedures, with traceability from resin lot to finished carton. Certification details are supplied on request with the quote.

equipment.title: TODO_TRANSLATE: Tooling built and maintained on site.
equipment.body: TODO_TRANSLATE: Moulds are cut, trialled and maintained in-house. That is the difference between a new format being a scheduling question and a supply-chain one, and it is what keeps revision cost and lead time under our own control.
